description: Testing, final integration verification, and production-readiness. Add meaningful tests for critical paths (API validation, status transitions, code generation), verify Docker build, add health check endpoint, and ensure the complete flow works end-to-end.
steps: Install dev dependencies: jest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, ts-jest or @swc/jest, jest-environment-jsdom.
Create jest.config.ts configured for Next.js (with moduleNameMapper for @/ alias, transform for TypeScript, testEnvironment jsdom for component tests).
Create src/lib/__tests__/codes.test.ts - Test code generation: codes are correct length, no ambiguous characters (0, O, I, l, 1), uniqueness over 1000 generations.

Create src/lib/__tests__/validation.test.ts - Test validateStatusTransition: new->seen OK, new->done OK, seen->done OK, done->anything rejected, seen->new rejected. Test validateRequestCategory with valid/invalid inputs. Test validateDeliveryTarget with missing fields.

Create src/lib/__tests__/ai.test.ts - Test scanFridgePhotos: mock fetch to simulate OpenAI response. Test missing API key returns friendly error. Test API error returns friendly error. Test empty/unreadable result returns friendly error. Test successful parse returns drink names array.
Create src/components/__tests__/RequestTracker.test.tsx - Test renders three status steps. Test highlights correct current step for each status. Test 'Seen' step is visually distinct.
Create src/components/__tests__/ErrorMessage.test.tsx - Test renders error text. Test is visible and styled appropriately.
Create src/app/api/health/route.ts - GET endpoint returning {status: 'ok', timestamp: ISO string}. Used for Docker health checks and deployment readiness.
Update Dockerfile to include HEALTHCHECK instruction using the health endpoint.
Verify npm run build succeeds with all files in place.
Verify npm test passes all tests.
acceptance_criteria: npm test runs and all tests pass
Code generation tests verify no ambiguous characters and correct length
Status transition validation tests cover all valid and invalid transitions
AI scan tests verify graceful degradation on all failure modes
RequestTracker component test verifies visual distinction of Seen state
Health endpoint returns 200 with status ok
verification: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass with meaningful assertions
Run npm run build and confirm successful compilation
Run docker build -t partyswoop:test . and confirm image builds
findings: 1. nanoid v5 is ESM-only; required adding transpilePackages: ['nanoid'] in next.config.js for Jest to transform it (next/jest uses this to build transformIgnorePatterns). 2. Docker environment uses Podman which defaults to OCI format - HEALTHCHECK requires --format docker flag for Podman but works natively with real Docker. 3. Prisma logs libssl warnings during Docker build but the Next.js build completes successfully. 4. All 53 tests pass. 5. @testing-library/jest-dom v7 requires Node >= 22 (not available in the node:20-alpine Docker image) but this only affects dev dependencies, not the production build.
